Flower Hero Page Design

A Visually Appealing Landing Section For A Flower Shop App, Crafted To Capture Attention Instantly. The Design Highlights Elegance, Seasonal Offerings, And Easy Navigation — Giving Users A Warm And Welcoming First Impression. The Focus Was On Aesthetics, Typography, And Hierarchy To Ensure The Brand’s Vibe Blooms At First Glance.
